content.title: About
content.content: Turkey bacon is a lean product made from turkey meat that has been smoked and pre‑cooked. The reduced‑sodium version contains roughly half the salt of regular bacon, making it a better choice for low‑sodium diets.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turkey bacon has about 30 % less fat than traditional pork bacon.
Sodium reduction is achieved through special salt blends and fermentation.
The product is ready to eat after a quick heat‑up – it can be added to salads, sandwiches, or microwaved.
Often used in athletes’ and health‑conscious diets because of its lower calorie and fat content.
Unlike many smoked meats, turkey bacon does not require additional pan‑frying.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Using turkey instead of pork reduces saturated fat, supporting cardiovascular health.

items.title: Reduced sodium
items.content: Less salt helps control blood pressure and reduces kidney strain.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: A serving provides about 12 g of protein, aiding muscle maintenance.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains niacin, vitamin B6 and B12, important for metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Lower calories
items.content: Compared with regular bacon, calorie count is roughly 20 % lower.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to turkey meat.

items.title: Nitrate content
items.content: Like most smoked products, it may contain small amounts of nitrates, which should be limited with frequent consumption.

items.title: Additive sensitivity
items.content: Certain brands may include flavorings or preservatives that can trigger sensitivities.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Turkey bacon is ready after reheating. Add it to omelets, salads, pasta, sandwiches, or serve alongside eggs. For a crispier texture, heat in a skillet for 1–2 minutes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0‑4 °C in the original packaging. Once opened, consume within 5 days. When frozen, quality is maintained for up to 2 months.
